question: Can a finite receiver distinguish a feasible quadratic candidate, a valid global lower bound, exact optimality, epsilon optimality and an unresolved gap?
level: external exact rational research; applied-mathematics roadmap priority 5

mathematics.domain: All rational x in the caller-selected closed nonempty box; bounds also hold over the real box. Input encoding limits do not make a finite field or enumerate this box.
mathematics.objective: f(x) = (x^T H x)/2 + c^T x + d; n is 1 or 2; H symmetric positive semidefinite
mathematics.psd_check: n=1: H00>=0; n=2: both diagonal entries>=0 and determinant>=0
mathematics.lower_bound: For supplied rational anchor z (not required feasible), g=Hz+c; choose b_i=l_i when g_i>=0, else u_i. L=f(z)+g^T(b-z).
mathematics.justification: f(y)=f(z)+g^T(y-z)+(y-z)^T H(y-z)/2; final term nonnegative; chosen b minimizes the affine term on the full box.
mathematics.upper_gap: Verify x in the original box and U=f(x). L<=inf_box f<=U; gap=U-L. Positive gap does not prove x is nonoptimal; zero gap does not prove uniqueness.

request.axes: one or two distinct nonempty names; order binds vector components
request.H_c_d_box: H n*n matrix, c vector n, d scalar, box n pairs [lo,hi]; all canonical rational pairs [integer numerator,positive integer denominator], abs components<=64; lo<=hi
request.tolerance: canonical rational >=0 with input cap 64; absolute objective gap, not distance, relative error or physical energy
request.names_history: names 1..80 characters; history list 1..4 nonempty names; retained exactly

candidate.binding: profile exact; request canonical JSON identical to receiver-selected request
candidate.point: n canonical rational coordinates, component cap 64, in the original box
candidate.upper: exact f(point), rational components at most 512 bits
candidate.lower: null, or exact fields anchor,gradient,corner,value; anchor n rationals cap64 (may lie outside box); gradient n rationals, corner n rationals, value L, all at most 512 bits
candidate.claim: exact fields kind,gap. If lower null: kind UnknownLowerBound, gap null. Else gap U-L; kind ExactOptimal if gap=0; EpsilonOptimal if 0<gap<=tolerance; VerifiedGap if gap>tolerance.
candidate.order: check expected context and PSD, request binding, feasible point and upper, lower certificate, final claim. Preserve only verified components after later failure.

receiver.verified_feasible: null or {point,upper}; retained on absent or later invalid lower evidence
receiver.verified_lower: null or {anchor,gradient,corner,value}; retained on later invalid final claim
receiver.accepted_result: null unless complete valid certificate; then {kind,lower,upper,gap}
receiver.authority: all native/close/free flags false; malformed expected raw bytes can give expected_request null; receipts preserve decoded request otherwise

independence.producer: coefficient-polynomial expansion for evaluation and differentiation; affine corner chosen by explicit endpoint comparison
independence.receiver: matrix bilinear evaluation, explicit principal minors and sign-based corner formula; no import of producer or old experiments
independence.point_controls: exact rational finite samples retained as controls, not full-box proofs
independence.trusted: Both sides use Python standard library/Fraction. No proof kernel or hostile service guarantee.

budget.continuation: No automatic solver, precision refinement, new fuel or retries; preserve original failures before one justified correction.

controls: Coupled interior optimum, active-boundary optimum with nonzero gradient, rank-one tie and constant objective
Positive gap from a nonoptimal candidate and from a weak lower bound at an actually optimal point
Positive epsilon gap must not become exact equality; tolerance changes are question changes
Missing lower certificate preserves feasibility; malformed lower or final claim preserves only independently verified parts
Negative-coordinate rational reuse, outside-box anchor, signed linear objective and singleton box
Reject wrong feasibility, upper, gradient, corner, lower value, gap, optimality class, context binding and extra authority fields
Reject nonsymmetric and indefinite H, malformed rationals/dimensions/boxes/tolerances/history; input failure is not proof of infeasibility
protected: Original question, box, axis order, objective coefficients, tolerance and ordered history
PSD and symmetry are explicit assumptions checked before granting the lower bound
No assumption that zero gradient alone, matching means, a small simplex or epsilon residual establishes optimality
No native operation, M6 filler, universal grammar, new learned theorem, physical energy or acceleration claim
Existing receipts, library pins, native runtime and ledger-holder-exit obligation unchanged
